離觀測站最近的一片淺空。第一道光碎裂時，最小、最溫和的碎片落在這裡；每一位探索者: The stretch of shallow sky nearest the Observatory. When the first light shattered, its smallest, gentlest pieces fell here. Every seeker's first dive starts in these shallows.
漂浮的光塵結成一圈圈淡淡的礁石，像有人在深空裡掛了燈。光橋在這裡很少斷，是練習的: Drifting light has gathered into faint rings of reef, as if someone had hung lanterns in deep space. Bridges rarely break here; it's a good place to practise.

一口往下開的光井，井底是淺域最濃的一團光。再往下，就離開淺域了。: A well of light opening downward, with the densest light of the shallows at its bottom. Any deeper and you've left the shallows.
淺域之外，一片由舊光堆成的礁海。光在礁石之間反覆反射，走得越遠，迴光越亂；觀測站: Beyond the shallows lies a sea of reefs built from old light. Light bounces between the reefs, and the farther you go the more tangled the echoes. The Observatory raised its first guiding lamps here.
觀測站最早搭起的前哨。光橋在這裡靠岸、補給、再出發，碼頭的燈從來沒有熄過。: The Observatory's first outpost. Bridges berth here, resupply and set out again, and the dock lamp has never gone out.
兩顆小小的冷光衛星繞著礁石轉。兩顆月亮重疊的時候，礁縫裡的光會一次亮起來。: Two small, cold moons circle the reef. When they overlap, the light in every crevice flares at once.
一條鋪滿星砂的長廊。腳步越輕，揚起的光越多；太急的人，只會把自己埋進沙裡。: A long gallery paved with stardust. The lighter your step, the more light rises; the hasty only bury themselves in sand.
礁海盡頭一座無人的燈塔，按照沒人知道的節奏閃爍。有人說，它是在回應更深處的某個訊: An unmanned lighthouse at the end of the reefs, blinking to a rhythm no one knows. Some say it is answering a signal from somewhere deeper.
一群巨大的碑狀星體排成長列，彼此投下影子。觀測站相信，這些碑是第一道光碎裂時留下: A long line of huge stele-shaped bodies casting shadows on one another. The Observatory believes they are marks left when the first light shattered; the Stele Plain takes its name from them.
沿著碑列延伸的長廊。光在碑面之間來回折射，路線清楚，但影子偶爾會吞掉一兩道光橋。: A gallery running along the line of steles. Light refracts back and forth between their faces; the way is clear, but now and then the shadows swallow a bridge or two.
一座碑斷成好幾截，斷面刻著沒有人讀得懂的紋路。探索者會在這裡撿到帶著刻痕的光塵。: A stele broken into several pieces, its broken faces carved with patterns no one can read. Seekers find light here that carries the same marks.
碑影像潮水一樣漲落。漲潮時光橋最難穩住；退潮時，灣底的光會一次全部露出來。: Stele shadows rise and fall like a tide. At high tide bridges are hardest to hold; at low tide all the light on the bay floor shows at once.
最高的一座碑，碑面是空白的。站在碑頂往下看，整片碑影星團像一張還沒寫完的星圖。: The tallest stele, its face blank. Looking down from the top, the whole cluster looks like a star map no one has finished.
碑影後方是一道深谷，谷裡填滿了會發光的霧。霧會吞掉方向感，也會藏住光；觀測站的紀: Behind the steles lies a deep gorge filled with glowing mist. The mist swallows your sense of direction and hides the light, and the Observatory's records start to break up here.

一座由沉下來的光聚成的湖，湖面平得像鏡子。光橋接觸湖面的那一刻，最容易斷，也最容: A lake gathered from light that has sunk, its surface flat as a mirror. The moment a bridge touches it is when it's most likely to break, and most likely to come back full.

空間在這裡裂開，光從裂縫噴出來，又被裂縫吞回去。觀測站把這裡標成「殘酷」：光很多: Space splits open here; light bursts from the rifts and is swallowed back into them. The Observatory marks it “cruel”: there is plenty of light, but bridges often don't last the way home.
一大片碎裂的光面，每一片都映出不同方向的路。踩錯一片，光橋就斷在半空。: A wide field of shattered light, every shard reflecting a path in a different direction. Step on the wrong one and the bridge breaks in midair.
裂縫之間不停打著光的雷。探索者得在兩次雷鳴之間穿過去；時機對了，帶回來的光多到裝: Thunder made of light strikes between the rifts without end. Seekers must cross between two claps; get the timing right and there's more light than they can carry.
這道裂口的光是往回流的，光橋得逆著光走。走得越久，越分不清自己是在前進還是後退。: The light in this rift flows backward, so bridges must walk against it. The longer you walk, the harder it is to tell whether you are going forward or back.
名字來自觀測站最早的一份紀錄。那次光橋斷了三次才接回來，最後一段訊號只有一句話：: The name comes from one of the Observatory's oldest records. That time the bridge broke three times before it was rejoined, and the last signal held only one line: “The light here looks back at you.”
環繞 ROVYN CORE 的最後幾圈光環，也是星圖上最亮、最危險的地方。這裡的: The last rings of light around ROVYN CORE: the brightest and most dangerous place on the map. The light here is closest to the first light itself.
光環的最外圈，已經感覺得到核心的熱。多數探索者是在這裡，第一次看見核光真正的顏色: The outermost ring, where you can already feel the core's heat. Most seekers first see the true colour of the corelight here.
七層光冕一層壓著一層。每穿過一層，光橋就要重新校準一次。: Seven coronas, one pressed upon the next. Each one you pass through, the bridge has to be aligned again.
一道往核心延伸的光之階梯，每一階都比上一階更亮。沒有人知道它有幾階。: A stair of light reaching toward the core, each step brighter than the last. No one knows how many steps there are.

月光太冷，光塵都縮回了礁縫裡。: The moonlight was so cold that the light shrank back into the crevices.
只等到月亮重疊的尾巴，撿到一點點光。: They caught only the tail end of the overlap and picked up a little light.
一顆月亮躲起來了，光少了一半。: One of the moons hid, and the light was halved.
等到雙月重疊，帶回一份穩穩的光。: They waited for the moons to overlap and brought back a steady share of light.
月光照著礁縫，探索者照著月光。: The moonlight showed the crevices, and the seekers followed the moonlight.
雙月重疊得剛剛好，礁縫裡的光一次亮起。: The moons overlapped perfectly, and the light in the crevices flared all at once.
探索者在兩道月光之間撿到滿滿的光塵。: Between the two beams of moonlight, the seekers gathered armfuls of light.
雙月完全重疊，整片礁石像白天一樣亮。: The moons overlapped completely, and the whole reef was bright as day.
月光把礁縫裡藏了很久的光全部照了出來。: The moonlight brought out all the light that had hidden in the crevices for so long.
走得太急，揚起的星砂把光橋埋住了。: They walked too fast, and the stardust they kicked up buried the bridge.
迴廊今天很暗，星砂一顆都不肯亮。: The gallery was dark today; not a single grain would light.
星砂亮了一下就熄了，只帶回一些。: The stardust lit for a moment and went out; they brought back only a little.
腳步重了一點，光都沉到砂底了。: Their steps were a little heavy, and the light sank beneath the sand.
輕輕走過迴廊，揚起剛好的光。: They walked the gallery lightly and raised just enough light.
星砂在腳下沙沙作響，帶回一路的光塵。: The stardust rustled underfoot, and they brought home a trail of light.
每一步都揚起一片光，探索者走得越來越輕。: Every step raised a cloud of light, and the seekers walked lighter and lighter.
迴廊今天特別亮，星砂像雪一樣飄。: The gallery was especially bright today, with stardust drifting like snow.
整條迴廊的星砂同時亮起，像一條光的河。: All the stardust in the gallery lit up at once, like a river of light.
探索者回頭看，走過的路都在發光。: The seekers looked back, and the whole path behind them was glowing.
燈塔的閃爍和光橋對不上節奏，什麼也沒接到。: The lighthouse's blinking was out of step with the bridge, and nothing came through.
燈塔今天沒有亮，探索者在黑暗中折返。: The lighthouse stayed dark today, and the seekers turned back in the dark.
接到燈塔一次閃光，就只有一次。: They caught one flash from the lighthouse. Only one.
訊號斷斷續續，光也斷斷續續。: The signal came and went, and so did the light.
跟著燈塔的節奏，帶回一份光。: They kept to the lighthouse's rhythm and brought back a share of light.
燈塔閃了三下，探索者也帶回三份光。: The lighthouse blinked three times, and the seekers brought back three shares of light.
燈塔的節奏今天和光橋完全一致。: Today the lighthouse's rhythm matched the bridge perfectly.
探索者讀懂了燈塔的訊號，找到藏光的地方。: The seekers read the lighthouse's signal and found where the light was hidden.
燈塔整夜都亮著，像是在為探索者送行。: The lighthouse shone all night, as if seeing the seekers off.
探索者說，燈塔回應了更深處的某個訊號，然後光就湧過來了。: The seekers say the lighthouse answered a signal from somewhere deeper, and then the light came pouring in.
影子吞掉了光橋，探索者只好退回去。: The shadows swallowed the bridge, and the seekers had to turn back.
碑面的光今天全都折到別的方向去了。: Today all the light on the steles bent off in other directions.
在碑與碑之間撿到一點光，影子拿走了其他的。: They gathered a little light between the steles; the shadows took the rest.
迴廊太長，回程時光漏了不少。: The gallery was long, and a good deal of light leaked out on the way home.
沿著碑列走了一趟，帶回剛好的光。: They walked the line of steles and brought back just enough light.
碑面上的光一路折射，跟著探索者回家。: The light on the steles refracted all the way and followed the seekers home.
每一塊碑都把光折向探索者，收穫滿滿。: Every stele bent its light toward the seekers. A full haul.
迴廊今天沒有影子，只有光。: Today the gallery had no shadows, only light.
整排碑同時亮起，光像瀑布一樣從碑頂流下。: The whole row of steles lit at once, and light poured from their tops like waterfalls.
探索者說，碑影第一次為他們讓路。: The seekers say the stele shadows made way for them for the first time.
所有碑同時發出共鳴，核光的回聲沿著迴廊傳到了觀測站。: Every stele resonated at once, and an echo of corelight carried down the gallery to the Observatory.
碑列盡頭出現了一道從沒見過的光，探索者把它帶了回來。: A light never seen before appeared at the end of the steles, and the seekers brought it back.
斷碑的紋路今天是暗的，什麼都沒有。: The patterns on the broken steles were dark today. Nothing.
探索者在斷碑之間繞了很久，光一直躲著。: The seekers wandered among the broken steles for a long time, but the light kept hiding.
撿到幾顆帶刻痕的光塵，紋路很淺。: They found a few motes of light bearing marks, the patterns faint.
斷面上的光太碎，帶回來的不多。: The light on the broken faces was too fragmented; not much came back.
帶回一些刻著紋路的光塵，還是讀不懂。: They brought back some light carved with patterns. Still unreadable.
斷銘丘給了探索者一份安靜的光。: Broken Inscription Hill gave the seekers a quiet share of light.
斷碑的紋路亮了起來，一路指向藏光的地方。: The patterns on the broken steles lit up and pointed the way to the hidden light.
探索者撿到好幾塊帶著完整刻痕的光塵。: The seekers found several pieces of light bearing complete carvings.
整座斷碑像被重新點亮，刻痕裡流出大量的光。: The whole broken stele seemed to be lit anew, and light flowed from its carvings.
探索者說，碑文好像在跟他們說話。: The seekers say the inscription seemed to be speaking to them.
斷掉的碑在光中短暫地拼回原樣，碑文亮了整整一分鐘。: For a moment the broken stele came back together in the light, and its inscription shone for a full minute.
探索者帶回一塊刻著完整碑文的核光碎片。: The seekers brought back a shard of corelight carved with a complete inscription.
影潮漲得太快，光橋被淹沒了。: The shadowtide rose too fast and swamped the bridge.
探索者等了一整個潮汐，灣底還是沒露出來。: The seekers waited a whole tide, and the bay floor never showed.
退潮時撿到一點光，下一波潮水就來了。: They picked up a little light at low tide, and then the next tide came in.
影潮帶走了大半的收穫。: The shadowtide carried off most of the haul.
趁退潮撿光，趁漲潮回家。: Gather at low tide, head home at high tide.
影潮來來去去，探索者帶回剛好的份量。: The shadowtide came and went, and the seekers brought back just the right amount.
這次退潮退得很遠，灣底的光全露出來了。: The tide went out a long way this time, and all the light on the bay floor showed.
探索者算準了潮汐，收穫比平常多。: The seekers timed the tide just right and gathered more than usual.
影潮退到從沒退過的位置，整片灣底都在發光。: The shadowtide fell farther than it ever had, and the whole bay floor glowed.
探索者說，他們看見了灣底的另一座碑。: The seekers say they saw another stele on the bay floor.
影潮完全退去，灣底露出一整片核光，像一面鏡子。: The shadowtide drained away entirely, revealing a whole sheet of corelight on the bay floor like a mirror.
探索者站在灣底，聽見了第一道光碎裂時的聲音。: Standing on the bay floor, the seekers heard the sound of the first light shattering.
碑頂的風太大，光橋搭不上去。: The wind at the summit was too strong for the bridge to reach.
空白的碑面今天什麼都沒寫，也什麼都沒給。: The blank face of the stele had nothing written on it today, and gave nothing.
在碑頂停了一下，只帶回風吹剩的光。: They paused at the summit and brought back only what the wind had left.
爬上碑頂花了太多力氣，光少了一些。: The climb to the summit took too much out of them, and the light was a little short.
站在碑頂看了一眼星圖，帶回一份光。: They looked out over the star map from the summit and brought back a share of light.
空白的碑面映著光，探索者帶著它回來。: The blank face reflected the light, and the seekers brought it home.
碑頂的光比想像中多，整座碑都在發亮。: There was more light at the summit than they'd imagined; the whole stele was glowing.
探索者在碑頂找到一圈光塵，像是有人留下的。: The seekers found a ring of light at the summit, as if someone had left it there.
空白的碑面突然浮現出光的紋路，光塵從紋路裡湧出。: Patterns of light suddenly surfaced on the blank face, and light poured from them.
從碑頂往下看，整片碑影星團都在為探索者發光。: Looking down from the summit, the whole Stele Shadows cluster was shining for the seekers.
空白的碑面上，第一次出現了一個字。沒有人認得，但它是用核光寫的。: For the first time, a single character appeared on the blank face. No one could read it, but it was written in corelight.
探索者在碑頂接住了一道從核心直射過來的光。: At the summit, the seekers caught a beam of light shot straight from the core.
霧門今天關上了，光橋穿不過去。: The Mistgate was closed today, and the bridge couldn't get through.
霧太濃，探索者找不到門在哪裡。: The mist was so thick the seekers couldn't find the gate.
勉強穿過霧門，回程時被霧吃掉了一些光。: They barely made it through the Mistgate, and the mist ate some of the light on the way back.
霧門窄得只夠一個人過，光只帶得動一點。: The gate was barely wide enough for one, so they could only carry a little light.
穿過霧門，又穿回來，帶著一份穩穩的光。: Through the Mistgate and back again, carrying a steady share of light.
霧門今天很配合，進出都很順。: The Mistgate was cooperative today; in and out without trouble.
霧門後面堆著一團光，探索者一次帶了回來。: A heap of light lay behind the Mistgate, and the seekers brought it all back in one go.
霧散開了一下，剛好讓探索者看見藏光的地方。: The mist parted for a moment, just long enough for the seekers to see where the light was hidden.
霧門整個打開，深谷的光像潮水一樣湧了出來。: The Mistgate opened wide, and the gorge's light poured out like a tide.
探索者說，霧門的另一邊比他們想像的亮得多。: The seekers say the far side of the Mistgate was far brighter than they'd imagined.
霧門中央亮起一道核光，把整片深谷都照透了。: A beam of corelight lit up in the middle of the Mistgate and shone right through the gorge.
探索者在霧門下接到了核光的回聲，霧都被震散了。: Beneath the Mistgate the seekers caught an echo of corelight, and the mist was shaken apart.
跟著聲音走了很久，聲音停了，光也沒有。: They followed the voices for a long time; the voices stopped, and there was no light.
低語太多，探索者分不清哪一個是對的。: There were too many whispers for the seekers to tell which was right.
跟著一個聲音找到一點光，其他聲音帶走了剩下的。: Following one voice, they found a little light; the other voices took the rest.
聽著低語，找到了該找的光。: Listening to the whispers, they found the light they came for.
谷裡的聲音今天很溫和，像在指路。: The voices in the vale were gentle today, as if showing the way.
低語越來越清楚，最後變成一句『在這裡』。: The whispers grew clearer and clearer, until they became a single phrase: “Over here.”
探索者跟著聲音，找到了一整片光塵。: Following the voices, the seekers found a whole field of light.
整座山谷的低語同時說出同一句話，光從四面八方湧來。: Every whisper in the vale said the same thing at once, and light poured in from all sides.
探索者說，聲音一路送他們回到光塔。: The seekers say the voices escorted them all the way back to the spire.
低語變成了歌聲，核光隨著歌聲一起流進光橋。: The whispers turned to song, and corelight flowed into the bridge along with it.
探索者聽見有人用 Rovyn 的聲音說：『把它帶回去。』: The seekers heard someone say, in Rovyn's voice: “Take it home.”
光橋碰到湖面的瞬間就斷了。: The bridge broke the instant it touched the lake.
湖面平得像鏡子，探索者看見的只有自己。: The lake was flat as a mirror, and all the seekers saw was themselves.
從湖面撈起一點光，大部分又沉了回去。: They scooped a little light from the surface; most of it sank back down.
湖面起了漣漪，光跟著散開。: Ripples spread across the lake, and the light scattered with them.
小心地從湖面取了一瓢光。: They carefully drew a ladle of light from the lake.
沉光湖今天很安靜，給了剛好的份量。: Sunken Light Lake was calm today and gave just the right amount.
湖底的光浮了上來，探索者撈了好幾瓢。: Light rose from the lakebed, and the seekers drew ladle after ladle.
光橋穩穩地停在湖面上，探索者裝滿了光。: The bridge rested steadily on the water, and the seekers filled up with light.
整座湖的光往上翻湧，光橋差點被撐滿。: All the light in the lake welled upward, and the bridge was nearly filled to bursting.
探索者說，他們在湖底看見了一座倒過來的光塔。: The seekers say they saw an upside-down spire at the bottom of the lake.
湖面裂開，一道核光從湖底直衝上來。: The surface split, and a beam of corelight shot up from the lakebed.
探索者把整座湖最亮的那一團光帶了回來，湖面暗了一整天。: The seekers brought back the brightest light in the whole lake, and the lake stayed dark all day.
霧濃到像牆，光橋撐不過去。: The mist was thick as a wall, and the bridge couldn't push through.
霧心今天不讓任何人靠近。: The Mistheart let no one near today.
在霧心邊緣撿到一點光，再往前就看不見了。: They picked up a little light at the edge of the Mistheart; any farther and they couldn't see.
霧心的壓力壓碎了一部分光塵。: The pressure of the Mistheart crushed some of the light.
穿進霧心又穿出來，帶回一份不一樣的光。: Into the Mistheart and out again, bringing back a different kind of light.
霧心今天稍微讓開了一點。: The Mistheart gave way a little today.
霧心中間有一塊空地，堆滿了光。: There was a clearing in the middle of the Mistheart, piled high with light.
探索者在濃霧裡找到了一團不會被霧遮住的光。: In the thick mist, the seekers found a light the mist couldn't hide.
霧心突然散開，露出深谷最深處的光源。: The Mistheart suddenly cleared, revealing the light source at the very bottom of the gorge.
探索者說，霧心的正中央是亮的，一直都是。: The seekers say the very centre of the Mistheart is bright, and always has been.
霧心散盡，核光的回聲在深谷裡迴盪了好久。: The Mistheart cleared completely, and an echo of corelight rang through the gorge for a long time.
探索者帶回一團霧，霧裡包著一小片核光。: The seekers brought back a wisp of mist with a sliver of corelight wrapped inside.
踩錯了一片鏡子，光橋斷在半空。: They stepped on the wrong shard, and the bridge broke in midair.
每一片鏡子都映著不同的路，探索者全都選錯了。: Every shard showed a different path, and the seekers chose wrong every time.
找到一片映著光的鏡子，可惜只有一小片。: They found a shard reflecting light. A pity it was so small.
鏡面反射讓光散掉了一半。: The reflections scattered half the light.
踩著正確的鏡片，一路走過碎鏡原。: Stepping on the right shards, they crossed the whole Shattered Mirror Field.
碎鏡今天照出了正確的方向。: Today the shattered mirrors showed the right way.
好幾片鏡子同時映出光，探索者一片一片撿回來。: Several shards reflected light at once, and the seekers gathered them one by one.
碎鏡原今天像一面拼好的大鏡子。: Today the Shattered Mirror Field looked like one great mirror pieced back together.
整片碎鏡同時反射出核光，探索者被光包圍。: Every shard reflected corelight at once, and the seekers were surrounded by light.
探索者說，每一片鏡子裡都有一份光等著他們。: The seekers say every shard held a share of light waiting for them.
所有碎鏡在一瞬間拼回原樣，映出了第一道光的樣子。: In an instant every shard fell back into place and showed the shape of the first light.
探索者在鏡中看見核心，然後帶回了一片它的倒影。: The seekers saw the core in the mirror, and brought back a piece of its reflection.
雷擊落在光橋正中央，什麼都沒留下。: Lightning struck the middle of the bridge and left nothing behind.
雷聲太密，探索者找不到空檔穿過去。: The thunder came too fast for the seekers to find a gap.
在兩次雷鳴之間抓到一點光，第三聲雷就來了。: They grabbed a little light between two claps, and then the third came.
雷光太亮，光塵被震散了。: The lightning was so bright it shook the light apart.
數準了雷鳴，平安穿過峽谷。: They timed the thunder right and crossed the gorge safely.
在雷聲的間隙裡，帶回一份光。: In the gaps between the thunder, they brought back a share of light.
雷光照亮了峽谷深處的光堆，探索者裝滿了光。: The lightning lit up heaps of light deep in the gorge, and the seekers filled up.
探索者在雷鳴之間來回好幾趟。: The seekers made several trips back and forth between the claps.
一道巨雷劈開了峽谷，裡面的光一次傾瀉出來。: A huge bolt split the gorge open, and the light inside poured out all at once.
探索者說，雷光和光塵在那一刻是同一種東西。: The seekers say that for that moment, the lightning and the light were the same thing.
整座峽谷的雷同時落下，化成一道核光，沿著光橋流回觀測站。: Every bolt in the gorge fell at once and became a single beam of corelight that flowed back along the bridge to the Observatory.
探索者接住了一道雷。那是核光。: The seekers caught a bolt of lightning. It was corelight.
逆流太強，光橋被推回了起點。: The backflow was too strong, and the bridge was pushed back to where it started.
探索者在裂口裡走了很久，發現自己一直在原地。: The seekers walked in the rift for a long time, only to find they hadn't moved.
逆著光走了一段，只帶回一點被沖下來的光。: They walked against the light for a while and brought back only a little that washed down.
逆著光一步一步走，帶回一份應得的光。: Step by step against the light, they brought back the share they'd earned.
裂口今天的逆流比較溫和。: The backflow in the rift was gentler today.
逆流帶來的光比想像中多，探索者順手撈了一大把。: The backflow carried more light than expected, and the seekers scooped up a big handful.
探索者找到逆流裡的漩渦，那裡堆著光。: The seekers found an eddy in the backflow where light had piled up.
逆流突然反轉，把裂口深處的光全推向探索者。: The backflow suddenly reversed and pushed all the light from deep in the rift toward the seekers.
探索者說，那一刻他們不用走，光自己湧上來了。: The seekers say that for that moment they didn't have to walk; the light came to them.
逆流停止的瞬間，裂口深處亮起了核光。: The instant the backflow stopped, corelight lit up deep in the rift.
探索者逆著光走到了盡頭，帶回了裂口的源頭。: The seekers walked against the light to the very end, and brought back the source of the rift.
光橋斷了三次，第四次才接回來。探索者回來了，手裡什麼也沒有。: The bridge broke three times and held on the fourth. The seekers came back with nothing in their hands.
隙縫裡的光回頭看了探索者一眼，然後消失了。: The light in the gap looked back at the seekers once, then vanished.
從隙縫邊緣撿到一點光，再往裡面就太危險了。: They picked up a little light at the edge of the gap; any deeper was too dangerous.
探索者帶回的光很少，但他們帶回了自己。: The seekers brought back very little light, but they brought themselves back.
穿過無返隙，然後回來了。這本身就是一件事。: Through the No-Return Gap, and back again. That alone is something.
隙縫今天很安靜，讓探索者帶走一份光。: The gap was quiet today and let the seekers take a share of light.
隙縫裡的光比紀錄上說的還多。: There was more light in the gap than the records said.
探索者說，光回頭看他們的時候，是友善的。: The seekers say that when the light looked back at them, it was friendly.
無返隙的光整片湧出，探索者差點被光推回觀測站。: Light poured out of the No-Return Gap, and the seekers were nearly pushed all the way back to the Observatory.
